title: Mystery Booster Commander Edition: card flavor text

entities.name: Ekthi, Contaminator Priest
entities.description: A priest who preaches that a vessel becomes pure only through sacred infection.

entities.name: Yume, Chronicler of Valor
entities.description: A chronicler of valor, linked to the tales of heroics told between matches at Valor's Reach.

entities.name: Valor's Reach
entities.description: A place where matches are held and tales of heroics are told between them.

entities.name: Flitwing, Lyev Detective
entities.description: A detective who notices the little details and treats tiny mistakes as big clues.

entities.name: Grandmother Goby
entities.description: A caretaker of a fry nursery, which she wraps in nullwater to shield the little ones from the ruckus of wayward mages.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: A teacher who urges students to turn their studies into uncompromising power to become royal mages.

entities.name: Istvan, Butcher of Eln
entities.description: A man who haunts the woods of Terisiare, said to be more frightening than any beast there.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: A land with woods haunted by Istvan.

entities.name: Kuroki, Thief of Talents
entities.description: A being ever seeking a voice all its own.

entities.name: Chira, All In
entities.description: A risk-taker whose motto is "No risk, no reward!"

entities.name: Jabs, Mistress of Mockery
entities.description: A performer whose shows all have a captive audience.

entities.name: Joven
entities.description: A thief paired with Chandler.

entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: A thief paired with Joven.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A guardian of the land who teaches that the land lives and breathes and must be nurtured.

entities.name: Blor the Impervious
entities.description: A boastful figure who proclaims his defenses still impervious.

entities.name: Glava, Five-Advents Mage
entities.description: A mage associated with the teachings of the Path of the Pentarch on the Five Advents.

entities.name: Path of the Pentarch
entities.description: A writing teaching that the Third Advent brings hunger that begets growth.

entities.name: Third Advent
entities.description: One of the Advents described in the Path of the Pentarch, which brings hunger.

entities.name: Maular, the Next Evolution
entities.description: An unnatural ruler for the natural world.

entities.name: Meatsqueak, Hoard Lord
entities.description: A squirrel in Krosa that never goes hungry.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A place where Meatsqueak lives.

entities.name: Chief Magistrate of Mercadia
entities.description: The ruler of Mercadia, whose throne was his in appearance only.

entities.name: Davvol, Evincar of Rath
entities.description: The evincar of Rath, who hopes returning hunters bring him something good for his birthday.

entities.name: Elda, Conjurer of Spectacle
entities.description: A showy conjurer who encourages kids to try her tricks at home.

entities.name: Homer, the Hermit
entities.description: A hermit who needs no destination, only a direction, offering respite to weary travelers on the sea floor.

entities.name: Lyna, Veil of Vengeance
entities.description: A vengeful figure who says Phyrexia has much to answer for.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The realm Lyna holds accountable for its deeds.

entities.name: The Madcap Jester
entities.description: A jester; he who bears the cap laughs last.

entities.name: The Muckslinger Gang
entities.description: A gang whose bid to become an eleventh guild was rejected by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon who enthusiastically rejected the Muckslinger Gang's bid to become an eleventh guild.

entities.name: Nephilim Epochal
entities.description: A nephilim whose awakening stirred the five from their slumber.

entities.name: Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned
entities.description: A returned lord of Tresserhorn meant to reign in Lim-Dûl's stead.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A former ruler in whose stead Tresserhorn's Lord reigns.

entities.name: Uugguu, the Omniplasm
entities.description: An ooze that neither hunts nor hungers but waits as all oozes eventually find their way back to it.

entities.name: Whtz, the Bibliophile
entities.description: A being created to keep the library well-stocked.

entities.name: Zagorka, Mother of Sanctum
entities.description: The first to call the city of Sanctum home, whose sanctuary many would follow her to find.

entities.name: Valko Indorian
entities.description: A speaker of Phyrexian whose words speak of organic beings weeping and Phyrexian comfort.

entities.name: Aline Corralurn
entities.description: Author of the verse "Inheritance," about mage-made things rusting through the ages.

entities.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
entities.description: A figure who asks what anyone has that he cannot obtain.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who describes mana as possibility not yet given form.

entities.name: Kenjek
entities.description: Captain of the Thousand Swords who values prepared, headlong charges into combat.

entities.name: Thousand Swords
entities.description: A fighting company captained by Kenjek.

entities.name: Rho
entities.description: A veteran hero who advises finding home where you can.

events.summary: The Muckslinger Gang bid to become an eleventh guild, and Niv-Mizzet enthusiastically rejected it.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet enthusiastically rejected their bid to become an eleventh guild.

events.summary: The Nephilim Epochal awoke, and the five stirred from their slumber.
events.quote: When it awoke, the five stirred from their slumber.

events.summary: Zagorka became the first to call the city home; many more followed to find its sanctuary.
events.quote: She had been the first to call the city home.

relations.quote: No beast in Terisiare is more frightening than the man who haunts its woods.
One squirrel in Krosa never goes hungry.

relations.note: Their guild bid was rejected by him.
relations.quote: Niv-Mizzet enthusiastically rejected their bid to become an eleventh guild.
In Lim-Dûl's stead may he forever reign.
